title: VB-GRAMG may cost states up to 6 times more than Mgnrega: PRS report
description:
The new rural employment scheme VB-GRAMG would have cost states six times more compared to MGNREGA if it had been implemented in the previous fiscal, a report by think tank PRS Legislative Research says, with larger states like Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh bearing the burden of an additional spending of Rs 2,000-3,000 crore.
In its 'State of State Finances Report 2026-27', PRS has given an estimate of what states would have spent if the Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-GRAMG), which was implemented from July 1, 2026, was in place in the 2025-26 fiscal.
"The VB-GRAMG scheme is being implemented from July 1, 2026. Had VB-GRAMG been in place instead of MGNREGA in 2025-26, states would have spent around six times what they actually spent under MGNREGA," the report says.
